result.evidence_A: About 155 words, exceeding the ~147 limit. Says "four new" channels, but PC is the existing model. Informal second-person tone. Gives the 48% result but omits the 6% comparison. Diamond-norm claim overstated: the body only calls it a more natural measure. Fidelity validity condition vague.
result.evidence_B: About 130 words, within limits. Clearly states problem, four channels, Hilbert-Schmidt minimization and the fidelity constraint, plus 48% vs at most 6%, all from the body. "Adding Clifford gates alone reduces distance" is supported. Omits amplitude damping results and the caveat that the CC vs PMC difference may not be significant. Minor issue: lowercase acronyms.
result.comparative_reason: B is more faithful and better structured. It stays within the length limit and covers the method and findings precisely. A exceeds the length limit, mislabels PC as a new channel, overstates the diamond-norm requirement, and uses an informal register.
